tasks.subject: Task 5: SpeakerStream (lazy decoder + decoded-PCM FIFO decoupling)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Per-speaker playout owning the cursor, a lazily-created per-speaker OpusDecoder, and a decoded-PCM FIFO. fillTick produces one 20ms frame per call by decoding due packets (any duration), PLC-filling holes in 20ms steps, re-anchoring on large jumps, retiring after terminator drains.

**Files:** app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/SpeakerStream.kt (SpeakerStream + ShortArrayFifo); app/src/test/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/SpeakerStreamTest.kt

**Acceptance Criteria:** first offer anchors cursor to timestamp+prebuffer; 40ms packet yields two 960-sample ticks; missing range PLC in 960 steps; decoder lazily created on first fillTick via newDecoder; retires after terminator drains; forward jump beyond reanchorGap re-anchors; SpeakerStreamTest passes.

**Verify:** ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests "*SpeakerStreamTest" → PASS

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/SpeakerStream.kt", "app/src/test/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/SpeakerStreamTest.kt"], "verifyCommand": "./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests \"*SpeakerStreamTest\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["first offer anchors cursor to timestamp+prebuffer", "40ms packet yields two 960-sample ticks", "missing range PLC-concealed in 960 steps", "decoder lazily created on first fillTick via newDecoder", "retires after terminator drains", "forward jump beyond reanchorGap re-anchors", "SpeakerStreamTest passes"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: AudioVoiceEngine (capture/encode + playback/mix, four blockers)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The VoiceEngine implementation: capture+encode inside nextOutgoingFrame (drains mic even while muted), a playback thread that de-jitters/decodes/mixes/writes AudioTrack (always writes 20ms silence when idle), non-blocking onIncomingFrame (copy + span, lazy per-speaker decoder on playback thread), mute, frame_number in 10ms units (+2 per 20ms), stop() that joins threads before freeing handles.

**Files:** app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/AudioVoiceEngine.kt (AudioVoiceEngine + AudioIn/AudioOut + AndroidAudioIn/AndroidAudioOut); app/src/test/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/AudioVoiceEngineFrameNumberTest.kt

**Acceptance Criteria:** nextOutgoingFrame advances frameNumber +2 per 20ms; muted drains mic + returns null + mute-edge terminator; onIncomingFrame non-blocking copy+span+computeIfAbsent, no decoder alloc; playback writes full 960 buffer every tick (silence when idle); stop joins playback thread before freeing handles; voiceStats StateFlow + setMuted work; injectable audio factories; testDebugUnitTest+assembleDebug BUILD SUCCESSFUL 0 failures.

**Verify:** ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:assembleDebug → BUILD SUCCESSFUL

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/AudioVoiceEngine.kt", "app/src/test/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/AudioVoiceEngineFrameNumberTest.kt"], "verifyCommand": "./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:assembleDebug", "acceptanceCriteria": ["nextOutgoingFrame advances frameNumber +2 per 20ms", "muted drains mic + returns null + mute-edge terminator", "onIncomingFrame non-blocking copy+span+computeIfAbsent, no decoder alloc", "playback writes full 960 buffer every tick (silence when idle)", "stop joins playback thread before freeing handles", "voiceStats StateFlow + setMuted work", "injectable audio factories", "testDebugUnitTest+assembleDebug BUILD SUCCESSFUL 0 failures"], "modelTier": "frontier"}
```
